description: Update an AI companion's internal state (loyalty, mood, grievances, memories). Call after events that would plausibly affect the companion's attitude toward the party.

fireTrigger.description: ID of a loyalty trigger that was fired — marks it as fired and applies its effect

hiddenAgenda.description: Set or clear the companion's hidden agenda

loyaltyDelta.description: Change to party loyalty (negative = losing trust, positive = gaining trust)

moodShift.description: New mood descriptor for the companion

newGrievance.description: A new grievance the companion is holding

newMemory.description: A new memory to record (always marked unresolved)

impact.description: Whether this left a good, bad, or complicated impression

playerLoyaltyDelta.description: Per-player trust changes keyed by player ID

reason.description: Why the loyalty changed — used in narrative context

name: update_companion_state
